When the catalogue legitimately changes, update this file in the same commit as
the new wardrobe.json and say why in _changes. Editing it is how you record a
deliberate change; the importer failing is how you find out about an accidental one.

2026-08-27: numbers unchanged, and deliberately so. Max confirmed all trousers are back from the tailor and that tops_28 has gone in the bin, so the DATABASE now reads Keep 84 / Tailor 6 and has six binned garments. This baseline describes data/wardrobe.json, the file that arrives from outside, which still says Tailor — so it keeps guarding that file unchanged. The divergence is recorded in item_field_sources as source='manual', which is what both the importer and export --compare read to tell a correction apart from corruption.
